info.title: API-DocTest-List Retail Orders Refunds-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Refunds API enables businesses to retrieve detailed information about refund transactions for retail orders. Designed for retail managers and financial analysts, this API allows users to monitor and track refund statuses, ensuring accurate accounting and customer satisfaction. Developers can use this endpoint to integrate refund data into their systems, streamline reporting processes, and enhance customer service operations. With comprehensive filtering options, users can easily access specific refunds, making it a vital tool for effective order management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of refund requests for orders.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all refund requests associated with customer orders. Use this to monitor and manage refunds effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refund operation on an order. This includes all necessary details and parameters required for processing the refund.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to order refunds. The body content is expected to be a string value that provides necessary information pertinent to the refund operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the refund.

resultId.description: The ID of the result returned by the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the refund operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the refund operation.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the refund operation in orders system.

createdBy.description: The user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit of the refund operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
